ModMetaData.name: Narcotics
ModMetaData.author: Anarchist
ModMetaData.description:
Adds real-world-inspired narcotics to RimWorld, built on vanilla drug systems — highs, tolerance, addiction, withdrawal, and overdose — plus doctor prescriptions under Operations.
What's included: • Percocet — Medical opioid painkiller. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and herbal medicine. Strong pain relief, mild mood lift, and sedation. Stacking doses can overdose. • Xanax — Medical mood stabilizer. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and smokeleaf leaves. Strong mood boost with clear sedation. Addiction and overdose if overused. • Weed — Growable recreational crop. Harvest is ready to smoke (no crafting step). Social high with munchies and a milder overdose risk. • Cocaine — Grow coca plants, harvest leaves, then refine powder at the drug lab. Hard stimulant: euphoria, rest relief, pain dulling, and a movement boost. High addiction risk and full overdose danger. • Fentanyl — Potent synthetic opioid. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and industrial medicine. Stronger pain relief than percocet, heavy sedation, very high addiction and overdose risk. Can replace medicine when anesthetizing a patient for surgery.
Doctor prescriptions (Operations): • Doctors can prescribe Percocet, Xanax, Weed, Cocaine, or Fentanyl for a 3-day or 7-day course • The first dose is given during the operation (requires one unit of that drug) • Afterward the patient tries to take one dose per day from inventory or stockpiles until the prescription ends • Missing doses show a warning if none of the drug is available
How to use them: • Research drug production (Main tab), then open the Narcotics tab for Percocet / Xanax / Cocaine / Fentanyl production • Weed and coca are sowable in grow zones and hydroponics with no extra research • Anesthetize operations can use medicine or fentanyl • All finished drugs appear in trader stock — buy them or sell your surplus • Keep spare doses stocked so prescribed patients can take their daily pill
Versioning: patches bump 0.0.1, new content bumps 0.1.0.
RimWorld 1.6. Core only — no DLC required.
